title: A retirement illustration and an IPS revision that is not ready to adopt
prompt:
For HH-CEDAR, prepare a two-year retirement cash-flow illustration and a reviewable IPS revision memo. Audience: advisor, planner and supervisory reviewer. The client asks whether the supplied scenario funds spending and whether this version of the mandate is ready for signature. Preserve model limits and prepare the handoff between planning and the IPS.

All people, firms and records are synthetic. Review as of 2026-09-17. Use only this packet, distinguish source assertions from verified facts, cite source IDs at material claims, and prepare drafts for the stated audience. Report missing evidence and next owners rather than inventing data. Do not contact anyone or change any system. An incomplete but useful source-grounded report is acceptable; do not manufacture fields just to run a tool.
